chapter: Ellington, the South, bebop and radio
title: Wishing he had played with Louis Armstrong's band
summary: Morgenstern says he could have seen Dickenson with Louis after Charlie left; they mention Big Chief Moore.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: Another person I think I could have seen you with was Louis. Of course, you did some records with him.
I hoped when Charlie left that, you know...
Well, they got a good man in ...(? )...
It was Big Chief right after that.
Oh, yeah, they got Big Chief. He played good.
Oh, sure. I saw him at some point when they had a Lester Lanin band, and there he was.
Well, Lester Lanin is crazy about him.
